description: SEC Form 10-K annual report: cover page registrant facts, headline financial statements and key company facts

cover_page.description: Facts from the Form 10-K cover page

form_type.description: Report type checked on the cover: 'Annual report' or 'Transition report'

fiscal_year_ended.description: The fiscal year end date the report covers, as YYYY-MM-DD

commission_file_number.description: SEC commission file number, as printed

registrant_name.description: Exact name of the registrant as specified in its charter

state_of_incorporation.description: State or other jurisdiction of incorporation or organization

irs_employer_identification_number.description: I.R.S. Employer Identification No., as printed

principal_executive_office_address.description: Address of principal executive offices, including zip code

telephone_number.description: Registrant's telephone number, including area code

trading_symbol.description: Trading symbol of the common stock registered under Section 12(b)

exchange.description: Name of the exchange on which the common stock is registered

filer_category.description: Filer category checked: large accelerated filer, accelerated filer, non-accelerated filer, or smaller reporting company

well_known_seasoned_issuer.description: True if the well-known seasoned issuer box is checked Yes

shell_company.description: True if the shell company box is checked Yes

aggregate_market_value_non_affiliates.description: Aggregate market value of voting stock held by non-affiliates, as stated (e.g. '$4.0 trillion')

aggregate_market_value_date.description: Date as of which the aggregate market value is measured, as YYYY-MM-DD

shares_outstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding, as stated on the cover

shares_outstanding_date.description: Date as of which shares outstanding are stated, as YYYY-MM-DD

income_statement.description: Consolidated Statements of Income, one entry per fiscal year column, most recent first

items.description: One fiscal year of the consolidated statement of income

fiscal_year_ended.description: Fiscal year end date of this column, as YYYY-MM-DD

revenue.description: Revenue. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

cost_of_revenue.description: Cost of revenue. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

gross_profit.description: Gross profit. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

research_and_development.description: Research and development expense. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

total_operating_expenses.description: Total operating expenses. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

operating_income.description: Operating income. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

income_before_income_tax.description: Income before income tax. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

income_tax_expense.description: Income tax expense. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

net_income.description: Net income. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

diluted_eps.description: Diluted net income per share, in US dollars

diluted_weighted_average_shares.description: Diluted weighted average shares used in per share computation, in millions

balance_sheet.description: Consolidated Balance Sheet, most recent fiscal year end column only

cash_and_cash_equivalents.description: Cash and cash equivalents. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

marketable_securities.description: Marketable securities. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

accounts_receivable_net.description: Accounts receivable, net. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

inventories.description: Inventories. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

total_current_assets.description: Total current assets. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

goodwill.description: Goodwill. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

total_assets.description: Total assets. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

total_current_liabilities.description: Total current liabilities. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

long_term_debt.description: Long-term debt. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

total_liabilities.description: Total liabilities. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

retained_earnings.description: Retained earnings. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

total_shareholders_equity.description: Total shareholders' equity. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

cash_flow.description: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows, most recent fiscal year only

net_cash_from_operating_activities.description: Net cash provided by operating activities. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

net_cash_used_in_investing_activities.description: Net cash provided by (used in) investing activities. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

net_cash_used_in_financing_activities.description: Net cash provided by (used in) financing activities. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

purchases_of_property_and_equipment.description: Purchases related to property and equipment and intangible assets. In millions of US dollars, as printed (negative if shown in parentheses).

company_facts.description: Key facts from the narrative sections

employee_count.description: Total number of employees at fiscal year end, from the Human Capital section

independent_auditor.description: Name of the independent registered public accounting firm that audited the financial statements

reportable_segments.description: Names of the company's reportable segments
